FFd20 Languages

49 distinct languages from the official FFd20 Linguistics tables, plus Common where granted by race. These are reference entries, not automatic eligibility for every race.

High-Intelligence bonus-language choices follow your selected race and final Intelligence modifier. Languages learned through Linguistics or other traits are separate.

Official FFd20 Linguistics source: finalfantasyd20.com/skills/ · Character wizard

Elemental languages

Aquan — Water and aquatic creatures

Auran — Air and flying creatures

Auroran — Ice-based creatures

Enochian — Divine and holy creatures

Ignan — Fire-based creatures

Runic — Arcane and non-elemental creatures

Terran — Earth and underground creatures

Thorian — Lightning-based creatures

Umbran — Shadow and unholy creatures

The official FFd20 list is used in addition to Pathfinder languages, which are not included in these FFd20-specific tables. Some races may select languages beyond this reference if their individual racial rules allow it.
